independence_evidence: Published and sold by Richardson itself from its own New York shop (325 Broome Street; https://us.richardsonshop.com/pages/contact); no media-group ownership.
qualifies_reason: Independent New York title whose print issue A12 (2025) is on sale from the publisher.
what_it_is: A large-format, occasional magazine that mixes sexually explicit photography with essays, fiction and interviews from artists and writers; each issue has a theme, and A12 is built around California with a cover shot by Harley Weir. It sits between an art book and a fashion magazine and is aimed at adult readers interested in subcultural photography and provocative writing.

cover_candidates.notes: Flat front cover but letterboxed into a square with white bars left and right, and under 1000px; the only cover image on the publisher's shop. Stockist images at antennebooks.com are angled photos, not flat.

uncertainties: Issue date taken from the publisher shop listing (published 2025-10-30) and a stockist's '2025' statement; no day-level release date found. Stockists give 160 pages and 30.5 x 22.6 cm, not recorded because the publisher's site does not state them. Cadence is roughly one issue every two years (A10 2021, A11 Dec 2023, A12 Oct 2025).
